| key | raw | shape |
|---|---|---|

Nothing was fabricated — no issuing body, date, figures, or work content were invented, per the 公文 rule that missing information becomes a placeholder.

## How it was built

`fixtures/` held nothing, so I wrote both JSON files byte-exactly as the brief specifies (verified the codepoints above). The generation flow is three files kept in the arm directory: `docxlib.py` writes the OOXML directly (`python-docx` is blocked by PEP 668 here, and writing raw XML also gave exact control over the GB/T fonts), `fields.py` does blank/missing resolution, `gen.py` runs both. Formatting follows GB/T 9704 — 小标宋 title at 二号, 黑体 level-1 headings, 仿宋 三号 body on a fixed 28pt line grid, 公文 margins, and a 「— 页码 —」 footer.

## Verification

- `postcheck.py` passes 9/9 with 0 errors on both files.
- Both render to a single clean page via LibreOffice → PDF → PNG. The first render stranded a one-character orphan on each title's second line; I added a semantic break at the 关于 boundary, which fixed both.
- I smoke-tested the filled and malformed paths (all fields populated; mixed blank/non-blank/None/non-string/wrong-type values) — every case produced a valid docx without aborting, and a fully-populated 工作总结 renders with correct numbered items and a single-line title.
- Scratch render directories were removed; only the deliverables and the generator scripts remain.

One note on the render above: this machine has no 仿宋/黑体/楷体 installed, so LibreOffice substituted Noto CJK. The `.docx` itself specifies the correct GB/T font names and will render as intended in Word/WPS.
